items.title: I’m a Voice Actor. Reddit Has Questions.
items.author: Brent Mukai
items.text:
Do you need a special voice to become a voice actor? What mistakes are beginners making? And can you actually record professional auditions in your closet?

I’m Brent Mukai, a professional voice actor and teacher, and I’m answering Reddit’s questions about voice acting—from auditions and character voices to home studios and getting started.

You may have heard me as Gyokko in Demon Slayer, Scratchmen Apoo in One Piece, or Mr. Narrator in Honkai: Star Rail. Today, you get my regular voice. Mostly.

Got a voice acting question? Leave it in the comments—it might make it into the next video!

Subscribe for more voice acting advice, behind-the-scenes stories, and professional goofball behavior.

items.title: Disney Lorcana's Hyperia City hits general release on Friday 23 October
items.text: Hyperia City, the 14th main set, went on general release on October 23 after prereleases on October 16. It adds Coco and the new "ink drops" mechanic.

items.title: Disneyland Resort Using Virtual Queue for Disney Lorcana: Hyperia City Release
items.text: Disneyland's Pin Traders in Downtown Disney ran an app-based virtual queue for the Hyperia City launch merchandise. Joining the queue didn't guarantee a purchase.

items.title: Where to buy Disney Lorcana: Hyperia City
items.text: GamesRadar reported that stock was running low in the days before launch.
